quote_versions.label: initial_offer
quote_versions.summary: Initial commercial proposal for the GlobalHotels modernization program.

quote_versions.label: revised_offer
quote_versions.summary: Revised commercial proposal after GlobalHotels requested improved pricing.

quote_versions.label: executive_exception_offer
quote_versions.summary: Final proposal containing a 17 percent discount requiring executive approval.

discount_requests.label: executive_exception_required
discount_requests.summary: Formal request for approval of the 17 percent discount in Quote v3.

approvals.label: executive_discount_exception
approvals.summary: Vice President approved the 17 percent discount exception for Quote v3.

calls.label: discovery_call
calls.summary: Discovery discussion covering GlobalHotels conference-room requirements.

calls.label: pricing_negotiation
calls.summary: Commercial negotiation after Competitor-X entered the opportunity.

transcripts.label: customer_requirements
transcripts.text: GlobalHotels expects approximately 300 conference rooms across 40 properties to have consistent AV functionality, centralized manageability, reliable integration, and enterprise support.

transcripts.label: competitor_pricing_pressure
transcripts.text: GlobalHotels stated that Competitor-X had presented materially lower pricing and asked Sony to improve its commercial offer.

transcripts.label: customer_expectation
transcripts.text: GlobalHotels emphasized that the proposed solution was expected to satisfy the capabilities discussed during the sales process and that any material limitation could affect the commercial negotiation.

email_messages.label: pricing_request
email_messages.text: Procurement requested materially improved pricing because GlobalHotels was evaluating a lower-priced competing proposal.

email_messages.label: decision_deadline
email_messages.text: GlobalHotels requested Sony's final revised commercial proposal before the upcoming procurement decision deadline.

pricing_policies.label: previous_pricing_policy
pricing_policies.text: The standard enterprise sales discount ceiling is 15 percent without executive exception approval.

pricing_policies.label: applicable_pricing_policy
pricing_policies.text: Discounts above 15 percent require Vice President approval before the commercial offer can be accepted.

product_documents.label: capability_unavailable
product_documents.text: Technical validation confirmed that a capability requested by GlobalHotels was not supported by the proposed solution at this time.

product_documents.label: capability_released
product_documents.text: The capability previously unavailable during the GlobalHotels sales cycle is now supported.

battlecards.label: competitive_guidance
battlecards.text: Competitor-X frequently competes aggressively on price in large enterprise AV opportunities. Sony guidance emphasizes solution quality, integration, support, and total customer experience rather than matching price alone.
